title: BasilBot replies
description: The wording of each reply related to BasilBot can be customized in the localization file. Values use ICU MessageFormat and may reference only the variables listed under Arguments. Replies omitted from the file keep their default wording from the code.

AnnounceAnticheatFlagPm.description:
Sends the room creator and referees a private message about an anti-cheat flag recorded in the room.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room being discussed.
- {name}: The room name.
- {player}: The name of the player flagged.
- {reason}: The anti-cheat signs detected for the player.

AnnounceAnticheatFlagRoom.description:
Announces an anti-cheat flag for a player in the room.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.
- {reason}: The reason associated with the anti-cheat flag.

AnnounceCountdownCancelled.description: Announces that the room countdown was cancelled.

AnnounceCountdownCancelledByRoundAbort.description: Announces that the countdown was cancelled because the round was aborted.

AnnounceCountdownCancelledByRoundStart.description: Announces that the countdown was cancelled because the round started another way.

AnnounceCountdownElapsed.description: Announces that the countdown has finished.

AnnounceCountdownElapsedForRound.description: Announces that the countdown ended but the round cannot start because no beatmap is selected.

AnnounceCountdownReplaced.description:
Announces that a running countdown was replaced by a new countdown.

Arguments:
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceCountdownStarted.description:
Announces that a room countdown has started.

Arguments:
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceCountdownStartedForRound.description:
Announces that a round has been scheduled to start after a countdown.

Arguments:
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceCountdownTicked.description:
Updates the remaining time in a room countdown.

Arguments:
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceCountdownTickedForRound.description:
Updates the time remaining before the round starts.

Arguments:
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceRoomClosingAnnounced.description:
Warns that an empty room will close unless a player joins before the deadline.

Arguments:
- {minutes}: The number of minutes before the empty room closes.

AnnounceRoomPlayerJoinedClosing.description: Announces that a player joined an empty room that was due to close, so it will stay open.

AnnounceRoundAborted.description: Announces that the active round was aborted.

AnnounceRoundEnded.description:
Announces that the round ended and gives the wait time for final results.

Arguments:
- {id}: The index of the round that ended.
- {seconds}: The countdown duration or wait time, in seconds.

AnnounceRoundStartedByCountdown.description: Sends the good-luck message when a round starts after a countdown.

AnnounceRoundStartedNoPlayers.description: Announces that the round cannot start because the room has no players.

AnnounceScoreMissing.description:
Names a player who has not submitted a score after the round scores are collected.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

AnnounceScoresReceived.description: Announces that all round scores have been received.

AnnounceScoresReceivedExcept.description: Introduces the list of players who have not submitted a round score.

AnnounceSettingsChangedCountdownCancelle.description: Announces that the countdown was cancelled because the room settings changed.

BotAvailableFaqEntries.description:
Lists the available FAQ entry names when a user requests the list.

Arguments:
- {entries}: The names of the available FAQ entries.

BotChainNotInLobby.description: Reports that command chains cannot be run in #lobby.

BotChainOnlyMpAllowed.description: Reports that command chains can contain only !mp commands that support chaining.

BotFaqUsage.description: Shows the !faq syntax when the entry name or the list keyword is missing.

BotHelpChannel.description: Describes the !channel command in the help list.

BotHelpFaq.description: Describes the !faq command in the help list.

BotHelpHelp.description: Describes the !help command in the help list.

BotHelpMp.description: Describes the !mp command in the help list.

BotHelpRoll.description: Describes the !roll command in the help list.

BotHelpWhere.description: Describes the !where command in the help list.

BotNo.description: Text shown for a false value in !mp settings.

BotNoFaqEntriesAvailable.description: Reports that !faq list has no FAQ entries to show.

BotNoFaqEntryFound.description:
Reports that the requested FAQ entry was not found.

Arguments:
- {entry}: The FAQ entry name requested by the user.

BotRollResult.description:
Shows the random number generated by !roll.

Arguments:
- {user}: The account name of the user who ran !roll.
- {points}: The random number generated by !roll.

BotRollUsage.description: Shows the !roll syntax when max is not a positive whole number.

BotUnknownCommand.description:
Reports an unrecognized command. It is sent in private messages or room channels, not public channels.

Arguments:
- {command}: The unrecognized command entered by the user.

BotWhereIsIn.description:
Answers !where with the account’s known country.

Arguments:
- {name}: The account name being looked up.
- {country}: The account’s country name.

BotWhereUnknownCountry.description:
Answers !where when the account’s country is unknown.

Arguments:
- {name}: The account name being looked up.

BotWhereUsage.description: Shows the !where syntax when the username is missing.

BotYes.description: Text shown for a true value in !mp settings.

ChannelCreated.description:
Confirms that a general channel was created.

Arguments:
- {name}: The name of the channel created.

ChannelDeleted.description:
Confirms that a general channel was deleted.

Arguments:
- {name}: The name of the channel deleted.

ChannelInvalidArguments.description: Reports an invalid channel name or !channel option.

ChannelListEntry.description:
Formats one channel entry in the !channel list output.

Arguments:
- {name}: The name of the listed channel.
- {read}: The account privileges required to read the channel.
- {write}: The account privileges required to send messages to the channel.
- {autoJoin}: Whether users automatically join the channel.
- {visible}: Whether the channel appears in channel lists.
- {topic}: The channel’s current topic.

ChannelMissingPrivileges.description: Reports that the caller needs the Moderator privilege to manage general channels.

ChannelNameTaken.description:
Reports that the general channel name is already in use.

Arguments:
- {name}: The channel name already in use.

ChannelNoChannels.description: Reports that the caller has no general channels they can view.

ChannelNotFound.description:
Reports that the specified general channel was not found.

Arguments:
- {name}: The channel name being looked up.

ChannelRefused.description:
Explains why a general-channel management operation was refused.

Arguments:
- {outcome}: The outcome identifying why the operation was refused or failed.

ChannelUpdated.description:
Confirms that a general channel’s settings were updated.

Arguments:
- {name}: The name of the channel updated.

ChannelUsage.description: Shows the syntax for the list, create, set, and delete !channel operations.

MpAbortedMatch.description: Confirms that the active round was aborted with !mp abort.

MpAddRefUsage.description: Shows the !mp addref syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpAddedReferee.description:
Confirms that a user was added as a room referee.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpAlreadyInThisMatch.description: Reports that the caller has already joined this room.

MpBanUsage.description: Shows the !mp ban syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpBannedFromMatch.description: Reports that the caller is banned from this room.

MpBannedPlayerFromMatch.description:
Confirms that a player was banned from the room.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpCannotInvite.description: Reports that the caller cannot invite the selected user under the room’s invitation rules.

MpChangedBeatmap.description:
Confirms that the room’s selected beatmap was changed.

Arguments:
- {artist}: The selected beatmap’s artist.
- {title}: The selected beatmap’s song title.
- {version}: The selected beatmap’s difficulty name.

MpChangedMatchHost.description:
Confirms that the room host role was transferred to another player.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpChangedMatchPassword.description: Confirms that the room password was set or changed.

MpChangedMatchSettings.description:
Confirms that the team type, win condition, and optionally the room size were changed.

Arguments:
- {teamType}: The room’s team type.
- {winCondition}: The condition used to determine the winning team.
- {size}: The new slot count, or “none” when the size was not changed.

MpChangedMatchSize.description:
Confirms that the number of player slots in the room was changed.

Arguments:
- {size}: The room’s player-slot count or the new count being set.

MpClearedMatchHost.description: Confirms that the room’s current host was cleared.

MpClosedMatch.description: Confirms that the room was closed immediately.

MpCountdownOutOfRange.description: Reports that the countdown duration is outside the allowed range of 1 second to 1 hour.

MpCreatedMatch.description:
Confirms that !mp make or !mp makeprivate created a room and identifies the room and its chat channel.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room created.
- {name}: The name of the room created.
- {privacy}: The room privacy state, either private or public.
- {channel}: The room’s chat channel name.

MpDefaultRoomName.description:
Provides the default room name, based on the room creator’s name.

Arguments:
- {name}: The room creator’s account name.

MpDestinationSlotNotOpen.description: Reports that the destination slot is not open when moving a player.

MpDisabledFreemod.description: Confirms that Freemod was disabled in the room.

MpDisabledMods.description:
Confirms that the specified mods were disabled in the room settings.

Arguments:
- {mods}: The mods being enabled, disabled, or currently applied.

MpEnabledFreemod.description: Confirms that Freemod was enabled in the room.

MpEnabledMods.description:
Confirms that the specified mods were enabled in the room settings.

Arguments:
- {mods}: The mods being enabled, disabled, or currently applied.

MpFreemod.description: The Freemod label shown in room settings or a player slot.

MpFreemodNotEnabled.description: Reports that an operation requiring Freemod cannot proceed because Freemod is disabled.

MpGenericFailed.description:
Reports a failed !mp operation when no more specific reply is available.

Arguments:
- {outcome}: The outcome identifying why the operation was refused or failed.

MpHelpKick.description: The help text for the !mp kick command.

The help text for the !mp list command.

Arguments:
- {commands}: The list of subcommands being shown.

MpHelpListrefs.description: The help text for the !mp listrefs command.

MpHelpLock.description: The help text for the !mp lock command.

MpHelpMake.description: The help text for the !mp make command.

MpHelpMakeprivate.description: The help text for the !mp makeprivate command.

MpHelpMove.description: The help text for the !mp move command.

MpHelpName.description: The help text for the !mp name command.

MpHelpPassword.description: The help text for the !mp password command.

MpHelpPrivate.description: The help text for the !mp private command.

MpHelpRemoveref.description: The help text for the !mp removeref command.

MpHelpSet.description: The help text for the !mp set command.

MpHelpSettings.description: The help text for the !mp settings command.

MpHelpSize.description: The help text for the !mp size command.

MpHelpStart.description: The help text for the !mp start command.

MpHelpTeam.description: The help text for the !mp team command.

MpHelpTimer.description: The help text for the !mp timer command.

MpHelpUnban.description: The help text for the !mp unban command.

MpHelpUnlock.description: The help text for the !mp unlock command.

MpHostTag.description: The host label shown in a player-slot entry.

MpHostUsage.description: Shows the !mp host syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpInUsage.description: Shows the !mp in syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpIncorrectPassword.description: Reports that the password entered to join the room was incorrect.

MpInvalidMods.description: Reports that the supplied mod list is invalid.

MpInviteUsage.description: Shows the !mp invite syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpInvitedToRoom.description:
Confirms that a player was invited to the room.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpJoinUsage.description: Shows the !mp join syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpJoinedMatch.description:
Confirms that the caller joined the room.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room joined.
- {name}: The name of the room joined.

MpKickUsage.description: Shows the !mp kick syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpKickedFromMatch.description:
Confirms that a player was removed from the room.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpLockedMatch.description: Confirms that the room’s player slots were locked.

MpMapUsage.description: Shows the !mp map syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpMatchAlreadyInProgress.description: Reports that a new round cannot start because a round is already in progress.

MpMatchBans.description: The heading for the room’s list of banned players.

MpMatchClosed.description: Reports that the operation cannot proceed because the room is closed.

MpMatchHasNoTeams.description: Reports that a team-selection operation cannot be used because the room has no teams.

MpMatchIsFull.description: Reports that the room has no open slots.

MpMatchIsLocked.description: Reports that the room cannot be joined because it is locked.

MpMatchIsPrivateNow.description:
Answers with the room’s current privacy status.

Arguments:
- {privacy}: The room privacy state, either private or public.

MpMatchNotInProgress.description: Reports that the requested operation needs an active round, but none is running.

MpMatchNowPrivate.description: Announces that the room became private and explains who can view its history.

MpMatchNowPublic.description: Announces that the room became public.

MpMatchReferees.description: The heading for the room’s current referee list.

MpMatchStarted.description: Confirms that the round has started.

MpMissingPrivileges.description: Reports that the caller is not the room creator or a referee with management authority.

MpModsUsage.description: Shows the !mp mods syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpMoveUsage.description: Shows the !mp move syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpMovedToSlot.description:
Confirms that a player was moved to the specified slot.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.
- {slot}: The player-slot number.

MpMovedToTeam.description:
Confirms that a player was assigned to the specified team.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.
- {team}: The team assigned to the player.

MpMpInDmOnly.description: Reports that !mp in can only be used in a private message to BasilBot.

MpNameUsage.description: Shows the !mp name syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpNoActiveRoomWithHashId.description:
Reports that no active room was found for the specified #ID.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room searched for.

MpNoActiveRoomWithId.description:
Reports that no active room was found for the specified ID.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room searched for.

MpNoBannedPlayers.description: Reports that the room’s ban list is empty.

MpNoBeatmapSelected.description: Reports that the operation requires a beatmap, but the room has none selected.

MpNoBeatmapWithId.description:
Reports that no beatmap was found with the specified ID.

Arguments:
- {beatmap}: The beatmap ID being searched for or displayed.

MpNoCountdownRunning.description: Reports that there is no countdown to cancel.

MpNoMatchesAvailable.description: Reports that the server cannot open any more rooms right now.

MpNoModChanges.description: Reports that the room’s mod settings did not change.

MpNoReferees.description: Reports that the room has no referees.

MpNone.description: Text used to indicate that no host or mod is set in !mp settings.

MpNotInARoom.description: Reports that the caller is not in a room and must join or select one.

MpNotScopedToAnyMatch.description: Reports that the caller has not selected a target room for !mp commands.

MpNowTargetingMatch.description:
Confirms which room !mp in selected as the target.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room selected as the target.
- {name}: The name of the room selected as the target.

MpOwnSlotLocked.description: Reports that a player cannot lock their own slot.

MpPlayerReady.description: Reports that mods cannot be changed while the player is ready.

MpPlayersOnly.description: Reports that the operation requires the Player privilege.

MpPrivateUsage.description: Shows the !mp private syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpRemoveRefUsage.description: Shows the !mp removeref syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpRemovedMatchPassword.description: Confirms that the room password was removed.

MpRemovedReferee.description:
Confirms that a user was removed from the room’s referee list.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpRoomLimitReached.description: Reports that the creator has reached the allowed limit for open rooms.

MpRoomNameUpdated.description:
Confirms that the room name was changed.

Arguments:
- {name}: The name of the user or room mentioned.

MpRoomPrefix.description:
A prefix added to replies to identify the room they refer to.

Arguments:
- {room}: The ID of the room being discussed.

MpRoomsLocked.description: Reports that room creation is currently locked by the server.

MpScoreNotCurrentRound.description: Reports that the submitted score is not for the current round.

MpSetUsage.description: Shows the !mp set syntax for changing team type, win condition, and room size.

MpSettingsAccess.description:
The !mp settings line showing the room’s locked, private, and password status.

Arguments:
- {locked}: Whether the room is locked.
- {private}: Whether the room is private.
- {password}: Whether the room has a password.

MpSettingsActiveMods.description:
The !mp settings line listing mods active for the room.

Arguments:
- {mods}: The mods being enabled, disabled, or currently applied.

MpSettingsBeatmap.description:
The !mp settings line showing the selected beatmap and its display name.

Arguments:
- {beatmap}: The ID of the selected beatmap.
- {name}: The selected beatmap’s display name.

MpSettingsBeatmapNotSelected.description: The !mp settings line shown when no beatmap is selected.

MpSettingsCreator.description:
The !mp settings line identifying the room creator by account ID and name.

Arguments:
- {id}: The room creator’s account ID.
- {name}: The room creator’s account name.

MpSettingsHost.description:
The !mp settings line showing the current room host.

Arguments:
- {host}: The name of the current room host.

MpSettingsInvalid.description: Reports that the room’s current settings are invalid.

MpSettingsPlayers.description:
The !mp settings line showing the number of players in the room.

Arguments:
- {count}: The number of players currently in the room.

MpSettingsReferees.description:
The !mp settings line listing the room’s referees.

Arguments:
- {referees}: The names of the room’s referees.

MpSettingsRoomName.description:
The !mp settings line showing the room name and ID.

Arguments:
- {name}: The current room name.
- {room}: The room ID.

MpSettingsSize.description:
The !mp settings line showing the room’s maximum number of player slots.

Arguments:
- {size}: The room’s player-slot count or the new count being set.

MpSettingsSlot.description:
The !mp settings line describing a player slot and its occupant.

Arguments:
- {slot}: The player-slot number.
- {status}: The slot’s readiness or other status.
- {team}: The player’s team, if the room uses teams.
- {id}: The account ID of the player in the slot, or empty if the slot is unoccupied.
- {name}: The name of the player in the slot.
- {tags}: Additional labels shown after the player name.

MpSettingsTeamMode.description:
The !mp settings line showing the team type and win condition.

Arguments:
- {teamType}: The room’s team type.
- {winCondition}: The condition used to determine the winning team.

MpSizeOutOfRange.description:
Reports that the requested number of slots is outside the allowed range.

Arguments:
- {min}: The minimum allowed number of slots.
- {max}: The maximum allowed number of slots.

MpSizeUsage.description: Shows the !mp size syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpSlotStatusNoMap.description: The slot status label used when the player has not selected a beatmap.

MpSlotStatusNotReady.description: The slot status label used when the player is not ready.

MpSpeedModsMatchWide.description: Reports that speed-changing mods can only be set for the whole room.

MpTagNotAvailable.description: Reports that Tag team types are only available in osu! mode.

MpTags.description:
The text appended after a player’s name to show slot labels.

Arguments:
- {tags}: Additional slot labels, such as Host or Freemod.

MpTargetAlreadyReferee.description: Reports that the selected user is already a room referee.

MpTargetInAnotherMatch.description: Reports that the selected player is in another room.

MpTargetIsBanned.description: Reports that the selected player is banned from the room.

MpTargetIsCreator.description: Reports that the selected user created the room.

MpTargetIsManager.description: Reports that the operation cannot target the room creator or a referee.

MpTargetIsObserver.description: Reports that the selected player is observing the room.

MpTargetIsPlayer.description: Reports that the selected user is playing in the room.

MpTargetNotBanned.description: Reports that the selected user is not on the room’s ban list.

MpTargetNotInMatch.description: Reports that the selected player is not in the room.

MpTargetNotObserver.description: Reports that the selected user is not observing the room.

MpTargetNotOnline.description: Reports that the selected user is offline.

MpTargetNotPlaying.description: Reports that the selected user is not currently playing.

MpTargetNotReferee.description: Reports that the selected user is not a room referee.

MpTeamUsage.description: Shows the !mp team syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpTimerUsage.description: Shows the !mp timer syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpUnbanUsage.description: Shows the !mp unban syntax when the command is called without valid arguments.

MpUnbannedFromMatch.description:
Confirms that a player was unbanned from the room.

Arguments:
- {player}: The name of the player affected or mentioned.

MpUnknownMpSubcommand.description:
Reports that the !mp subcommand was not recognized.

Arguments:
- {subcommand}: The unrecognized !mp subcommand.

MpUnlockedMatch.description: Confirms that the room was unlocked.

MpUserAlreadyInRoom.description: Reports that the invited user is already in another room.

MpUserNotFound.description: Reports that no account matched the supplied name or ID.
